svg.title: A fictional canal freight yard before and after conversion to a wetlands learning park
svg.desc: Both maps show a rectangular site boundary with a canal along north boundary, an east vehicle entrance and a retained crane near canal. Before conversion, the map shows a warehouse in west, a freight shed in centre, hardstanding in south, a rail spur from east entrance and a perimeter fence. After conversion, wetland cells replacing hardstanding occupy the south, a learning centre reusing warehouse footprint stands in the west, and an open shelter replacing freight shed stands in the centre. The plan also adds a loop path and boardwalk, a west pedestrian entrance and a small parking area at east entrance. Both panels are north-up and use the same 0-to-50-metre scale.

g.text: A fictional canal freight yard before and after conversion
Source: author-created fictional site plan for WeLearn Original Practice
